rows.title_short: The Race Horse Jockeys Retirement Act Of 2009
rows.abstract: \"The Race Horse Jockeys Retirement Act of 2008.\" Seeks to lower the retirement age of race horse jockeys from 60 to 55 years old in order for them to have more time to enjoy the fruits of their labor and have more opportunities to practice other horse-racing professions such as horse trainers, or even train jockeys immediately after their retirement.

rows.abstract: Seeks to promote international order and justice by denying the use of the Philippine territory by persons who are engaged or likely to engage in terrorism, criminal and other nefarious activities.
